description: Recommends the right sebbi.pro products for how someone builds (Python, Node, Lovable, Zapier, a website, a phone app...) and gives step-by-step setup with working code or a ready-made prompt. Pass their stack and what they want to achieve. Read-only.

device.description: Where they are working from, e.g. 'Android phone', 'Mac'

stack.description: How they build or what they use, e.g. 'Lovable website', 'Python on AWS', 'Zapier'

name: sebbi_setup_advice
title: Setup plan for their stack
